function: Joint configuration of stacked intelligent metasurface (SIM) phase shifts and user transmit power to maximize uplink secrecy rate against an eavesdropper (p. 5-6).
system: Multi-antenna BS with integrated SIM (M=4 layers, N=36 meta-atoms), K=2 single-antenna mobile users, one single-antenna eavesdropper, uplink, 3.5 GHz (p. 4, 11).
method: Deep reinforcement learning: PPO with Bi-LSTM, off-policy data reuse, policy feedback and multi-head attention (PPO-BOP); trained online by interaction with simulated environment (p. 7-10).
data_channel: Custom simulator: quasi-static spatially correlated Rician fading, path loss exponent 2, random-walk user mobility in 100 m x 100 m area; no external dataset (p. 4-5, 11).
test_conditions: Agent trained and evaluated in the same simulated environment; ASR reported while sweeping power, hardware-impairment level, SIM layers and atoms; no unseen scenario or adaptation (p. 12-13).
baselines: Non-learned: no SIM, fixed SIM phase pi with fixed or maximum power. Learned: DDQN, DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO (p. 11-12).
metrics: Achievable secrecy rate (ASR), episode reward and convergence curves (p. 12).
complexity: Big-O computational and space complexity of PPO-BOP for training and execution (execution O(Gamma)); no runtime or parameter count (p. 11).
q1_support: p. 4: "assumed to follow a spatially correlated Rician fading channel"; fading and path loss come from a custom simulator (Table I, p. 11), with no 3GPP model, DeepMIMO or measured data mentioned.
q2_support: p. 12: "Fig. 5 illustrates the variation of the ASR with the maximum transmit power"; this and the sweeps of RHI level and SIM size (p. 12-13) are parameter sweeps, with no model trained in one scenario and tested in another or adapted.
q3_support: p. 12: "several DRL baselines, including the double deep Q-network (DDQN)"; learned DDQN, DDPG, TD3, SAC, PPO and non-learned fixed-phase and no-SIM strategies (p. 11) are compared on ASR (Figs. 3-5).
q4_support: p. 11: "analyzes the computational and spatial complexities of PPO-BOP"; Section IV-E gives Big-O training and execution complexity, with execution O(Gamma).
q5_support: p. 11: "MUs are randomly distributed within the area"; the data come from the authors' own simulation, and no code or data link and no public channel dataset are given.
notes: Included, area 3: the learned PPO-BOP sets SIM phase shifts and user power, so the secrecy-rate (PLS) objective does not change the function. ris=1 because the SIM is a stacked metasurface at the BS. Channel is Rician, not 3GPP.
